Most books on public speaking focus on communication and negotiation, but they rarely teach you the fundamentals of articulation, pronunciation, and storytelling techniques. Nor do they show you how to handle awkward silences or unexpected situations—like being pulled into a street interview or suddenly asked to speak on stage. This book offers a systematic self-training method. By following the exercises step by step, you'll be able to confidently navigate various speaking scenarios and subtly transform the way your audience perceives you
